/.title: QuietKit — private file tools that never upload
/.description: Compress photos, strip EXIF metadata and merge PDFs entirely in your browser. No uploads, no accounts, no servers. Free and instant.

/tools.title: All tools — private browser-local file utilities
/tools.description: The full QuietKit toolbox: compress, convert or resize images, convert AVIF to JPG or back, remove EXIF and GPS metadata, inspect and strip the metadata inside a PDF, resize PDF pages to A4 or Letter, split a PDF into separate files, turn PDF pages into JPG images, build a PDF from photos, merge PDFs, add page numbers, extract text, then delete, reorder or rotate pages. Every tool runs locally in your browser.

/tools/image-compressor.title: Compress images in your browser, no upload
/tools/image-compressor.description: Free image compressor for JPEG, PNG and WebP. Resize, set a quality level and download — all processed locally in your browser with no uploads.

/tools/image-converter.title: Convert HEIC to JPG, PNG to JPG, JPG to WebP
/tools/image-converter.description: Convert iPhone HEIC photos and JPEG, PNG or WebP images in batches inside your browser. Transparent areas become white in JPEG, and nothing is uploaded.

/tools/avif-converter.title: AVIF to JPG converter — no upload, works both ways
/tools/avif-converter.description: Convert AVIF images to JPG, PNG or WebP that any software can open — or re-encode JPG and PNG as space-saving AVIF. Batch conversion entirely in your browser, nothing uploaded.

/tools/image-resizer.title: Resize an image to exact pixels — no upload
/tools/image-resizer.description: Resize photos to 1080×1080, 1584×396, 600×600 or any custom size. Crop to fill or fit the whole image, for one file or a whole folder — processed locally, nothing uploaded.

/tools/metadata-cleaner.title: Remove EXIF and GPS metadata from photos
/tools/metadata-cleaner.description: See the hidden EXIF data in your photos, including GPS coordinates, then strip it from one file or a whole folder. Cleaned copies come back as a ZIP; nothing is uploaded.

/tools/pdf-compress.title: Compress a PDF locally, no upload
/tools/pdf-compress.description: Shrink heavy PDFs by rebuilding each page as a JPEG at 110, 150 or 200 DPI. See the real before-and-after size. Runs entirely in the browser, nothing is uploaded.

/tools/pdf-compare.title: Compare two PDFs side by side, no upload
/tools/pdf-compare.description: Put two versions of a PDF next to each other, page through them together and highlight what changed pixel by pixel. Handles different page counts. Runs entirely in your browser — nothing is uploaded.

/tools/pdf-merge.title: Merge PDF files locally, no upload
/tools/pdf-merge.description: Combine several PDFs into one document in the order you choose. Everything happens inside your browser, so contracts and scans never leave your device.

/tools/pdf-remove-pages.title: Remove or extract pages from a PDF, no upload
/tools/pdf-remove-pages.description: Delete blank or sensitive pages from a PDF, or pull selected pages into a new file. Enter ranges like 1-3, 7, 10- and download — nothing is uploaded.

/tools/pdf-rotate.title: Rotate PDF pages locally, without redrawing
/tools/pdf-rotate.description: Turn all pages or only the sideways ones by 90°, 180° or 270°. Text and images are untouched, and the PDF never leaves your browser.

/tools/pdf-reorder.title: Reorder PDF pages with a simple order list
/tools/pdf-reorder.description: Move a signature page to the end or an appendix to the middle by typing the order, e.g. 4, 1-3, 5. Pages keep their quality and the file never leaves your browser.

/tools/jpg-to-pdf.title: JPG to PDF — combine photos into one PDF, no upload
/tools/jpg-to-pdf.description: Turn JPG, PNG and HEIC images into one PDF in the order you choose, on A4, Letter or fitted pages. Photos are processed locally and stripped of GPS metadata.

/tools/pdf-text.title: Extract text from a PDF in your browser, no upload
/tools/pdf-text.description: Copy or download the text inside a PDF page by page, or as one plain-text file. Scans are reported honestly instead of silently returning nothing. Nothing is uploaded.

/tools/pdf-page-numbers.title: Add page numbers to a PDF, no upload
/tools/pdf-page-numbers.description: Stamp page numbers on a PDF in the corner you choose — “7”, “7 / 24” or “Page 7 of 24” — with a live preview, an optional cover skip and nothing uploaded.

/tools/pdf-watermark.title: Watermark a PDF in your browser, no upload
/tools/pdf-watermark.description: Add a diagonal, horizontal or vertical text watermark to a PDF — centred or tiled, any opacity, all pages or a range — with a live preview. Nothing is uploaded.

/tools/pdf-metadata.title: See and remove the metadata inside a PDF
/tools/pdf-metadata.description: Read the author, producer, creation date and XMP packet a PDF carries, then download a copy with the property block emptied. Pages are untouched and nothing is uploaded.

/tools/pdf-resize.title: Resize PDF pages to A4 or Letter, no upload
/tools/pdf-resize.description: Put every page of a PDF on one sheet — A4, Letter, Legal, A5 or A3 — fitted to show it all or filled to cover the sheet. Rotation is normalised, text stays vector, nothing is uploaded.

/tools/pdf-split.title: Split a PDF into separate files, no upload
/tools/pdf-split.description: Cut one PDF into a file per page, fixed-size chunks, or your own ranges like 1-3, 4-9, 10-. Pages are copied rather than re-rendered, parts download as a ZIP, and nothing is uploaded.

/tools/pdf-to-jpg.title: PDF to JPG at 150–300 DPI, no upload
/tools/pdf-to-jpg.description: Turn PDF pages into JPEG images at 150, 200 or 300 DPI. Choose pages, keep a white background, download one file or a ZIP — rendered in your browser, nothing uploaded.

/tools/batch.title: Batch a whole folder: clean photos, merge PDFs, one ZIP
/tools/batch.description: Drop a folder of photos and PDFs. Photos are stripped of EXIF and GPS data, converted and compressed; PDFs are merged in name order, numbered and resized to A4. One ZIP back, nothing uploaded.

/tools/image-ocr.title: Image to text: OCR in your browser, no upload
/tools/image-ocr.description: Extract text from screenshots, receipts and scanned pages with an OCR engine that runs entirely on your device. English text, plain-text output, nothing uploaded.

/tools/pdf-form-fill.title: Fill in a PDF form locally, no upload
/tools/pdf-form-fill.description: Type into the text fields, tick the checkboxes and pick the options of a PDF form, then download a filled copy — flattened or still editable. Runs entirely in your browser.

/tools/pdf-sign.title: Sign a PDF in your browser, no upload
/tools/pdf-sign.description: Draw or type your signature, click where it belongs on the page, and download a signed copy. The document and your signature never leave your device.

/tools/qr-code.title: QR code generator — static codes, no upload, no tracking
/tools/qr-code.description: Turn a link, Wi-Fi password or any text into a static QR code with a live preview. Choose error correction, colours and size, download PNG or SVG — generated locally, nothing uploaded.

/tools/favicon.title: Favicon generator — ICO, PNG and manifest from one image
/tools/favicon.description: Turn one logo into a complete favicon set: multi-resolution ICO, Apple touch icon, Android Chrome icons and a web manifest. Everything runs locally in your browser.

/tools/password-generator.title: Password generator — strong random passwords, no upload
/tools/password-generator.description: Generate cryptographically random passwords with configurable length and character sets. Runs entirely in your browser with crypto.getRandomValues — nothing is uploaded.

/tools/image-watermark.title: Image watermark — tiled or centred text, no upload
/tools/image-watermark.description: Add a tiled or centred text watermark to photos and screenshots. Preview the result, batch a whole folder, download as ZIP — everything runs locally in your browser.

/tools/color-converter.title: Color converter — HEX, RGB, HSL with contrast and palette
/tools/color-converter.description: Convert between HEX, RGB and HSL. Check WCAG contrast ratios, see complementary and analogous colours, and copy CSS-ready values — all locally in your browser.

/tools/json-formatter.title: JSON formatter — validate, format and minify, no upload
/tools/json-formatter.description: Format, validate and minify JSON with precise error locations. Sort keys, copy or download the result. The parser runs locally in your browser — nothing is uploaded.

/tools/hash-generator.title: Hash generator — SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA-1, no upload
/tools/hash-generator.description: Compute SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA-384 and SHA-1 hashes of text or files entirely in your browser. Verify downloads and check integrity — nothing is uploaded.

/tools/markdown-preview.title: Markdown preview — write, render and export HTML, no upload
/tools/markdown-preview.description: Write Markdown and see it rendered live. Copy or download clean HTML, or keep the .md file. The renderer runs locally in your browser — drafts never leave your device.

/tools/text-diff.title: Text diff — compare two texts without uploading them
/tools/text-diff.description: Paste two versions of a contract, config or draft and see exactly what changed, line by line and word by word. Copy or download a unified diff. Runs locally — nothing is uploaded.

/tools/base64.title: Base64 encoder and decoder — Unicode-safe, no upload
/tools/base64.description: Encode text or files to Base64 and decode them back, with a URL-safe variant. Handles Unicode correctly and runs entirely in your browser — nothing is uploaded.

/tools/url-encoder.title: URL encoder and decoder — percent-encode, parse query strings
/tools/url-encoder.description: Percent-encode a value for a URL or decode it back, with component and full-URL modes. Parse a query string into a decoded key-value table. Runs entirely in your browser — nothing is uploaded.

/tools/word-counter.title: Word counter — words, characters, sentences, reading time
/tools/word-counter.description: Count words, characters, sentences and paragraphs with live reading and speaking time estimates and keyword density. Counts CJK text and emoji correctly. Runs entirely in your browser — nothing is uploaded.

/tools/case-converter.title: Case converter — UPPERCASE, camelCase, snake_case and more
/tools/case-converter.description: Convert text to UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, Sentence case, camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case or CONSTANT_CASE. Handles acronyms and digits, converts identifier lists line by line. Runs locally — nothing is uploaded.

/tools/slug-generator.title: Slug generator — title to URL slug, no upload
/tools/slug-generator.description: Turn titles into clean URL slugs: accents folded (é→e, ß→ss), emoji stripped, contractions joined, custom separator and max length. Converts a whole list line by line. Runs locally — nothing is uploaded.

/tools/uuid-generator.title: UUID generator — random v4 UUIDs, no upload
/tools/uuid-generator.description: Generate RFC 4122 version 4 UUIDs with crypto.getRandomValues — one or a batch of 1,000, in standard, plain, braced or URN form. Runs entirely in your browser — nothing is uploaded.

/tools/unit-converter.title: Unit converter — length, weight, temperature, data size
/tools/unit-converter.description: Convert between metric and imperial with exact legal definitions: inches to millimetres, pounds to kilograms, Fahrenheit to Celsius, and decimal versus binary data sizes. Runs locally — nothing is uploaded.

/tools/lorem-ipsum.title: Lorem ipsum generator — words, sentences, paragraphs
/tools/lorem-ipsum.description: Generate placeholder text from the classic Cicero word pool: exact word counts, sentences or paragraphs, with an optional traditional opening and HTML wrapping. Runs locally — nothing is uploaded.

/tools/timestamp-converter.title: Unix timestamp converter — epoch to date, both ways
/tools/timestamp-converter.description: Convert a Unix epoch timestamp (seconds or milliseconds) to a human date in UTC and your local zone, or type a date back into a timestamp. ISO 8601 and RFC 2822 included. Runs locally — nothing is uploaded.

/tools/aspect-ratio.title: Aspect ratio calculator — width, height, fit and fill
/tools/aspect-ratio.description: Enter any width and height to get the reduced ratio, or pick a ratio and a dimension to solve the other. Fit (contain) and fill (cover) a box, scale uniformly, see the diagonal. Runs locally — nothing is uploaded.

/tools/random-number.title: Random number generator — integers, decimals, unique draws
/tools/random-number.description: Generate cryptographically random integers or decimals in any range, singly or in batches, with an optional no-repeats mode and a seed for reproducible sequences. Runs locally — nothing is uploaded.

/tools/tip-calculator.title: Tip calculator — split the bill, round up or down
/tools/tip-calculator.description: Work out the tip and each person's share from the bill, a tip percentage and the number of people. Preset rates, custom percentage, and honest rounding that does not silently pocket the cents. Runs locally — nothing is uploaded.

/tools/percentage-calculator.title: Percentage calculator — of, is, change and reverse
/tools/percentage-calculator.description: Work out what a percentage of a number is, what percentage one number is of another, the percentage change between two values, or what number a percentage refers back to. Four modes, instant results, runs locally — nothing is uploaded.

/tools/age-calculator.title: Age calculator — years, months, days and next birthday
/tools/age-calculator.description: Enter a birth date and get the exact age in years, months and days, plus total days, weeks and months lived, and the countdown to the next birthday. Handles leap-day births and month-length edge cases correctly. Runs locally — nothing is uploaded.

/tools/px-to-rem.title: px to rem converter — single values and CSS snippets
/tools/px-to-rem.description: Convert pixels to rems and back with a configurable root font size. Convert a single value or paste a whole CSS snippet — every px and rem token is converted in place, everything else left untouched. Runs locally — nothing is uploaded.
